spouseRoom_Harvey: #$c .5#No air-traffic this morning, honey. But it's still fun to break out the equipment now and then.#$e#I'm working on a new model plane. It's so much more relaxing here than in my old apartment.

spouseRoom_Elliott: #$c .5#I think I might do some writing today.#$e#Will you be okay without my help?

spouseRoom_Shane: #$c .5#Beer or cider? Sometimes life can be challenging.#$e#Hi, @. I'll just hang out in here today and uh... maybe sweep the floor a little bit or something.
